summary: Tested master-file rename propagation into loan_applications (Month MIS) for all 6 master types, backend (16 pytest cases) + UI e2e. Core propagation works for exact-match names (verified via API for customers/executives/managers/banks/agents/companies and via UI by renaming 'TestClient' -> 'TestClient QA', which immediately appeared in MIS Apr-2026 and was reverted). BUG FOUND: propagation uses exact string equality, so real preview data whose loan value contains surrounding whitespace (customer 'Vishwa ' in loan vs master 'Vishwa') is NOT updated - the exact scenario in the request failed in the UI. All test renames reverted; test data cleaned.

critical.issue: Propagation uses exact match: db.loan_applications.update_many({field: old_name}, ...). Loans imported with trailing/leading spaces or different casing (e.g. customer_name = 'Vishwa ' while master name = 'Vishwa') are silently NOT updated, so MIS still shows the old name. Reproduced by pytest test_rename_propagates_when_loan_value_has_whitespace and by UI (renaming 'Vishwa' -> 'Vishwa Updated' did not change the MIS row). Fix: match with a case-insensitive, trimmed regex e.g. {field: {'$regex': f'^\\s*{re.escape(old_name)}\\s*$', '$options': 'i'}} (escape the name) and/or trim values on loan create/import.

minor.issue: contact_no propagation block runs update_many({customer_name: new_name, contact_no: old_contact}) - it silently no-ops when the loan's stored contact differs, and does not report how many loans were touched. Endpoint responses also never return matched/modified counts, so the UI cannot show 'N loans updated'.

_sync_loan_to_master does not trim (it does .strip() on the name, but the loan document keeps the raw untrimmed value), which is the source of the master/loan mismatch. agent_name is intentionally not synced to master_agents - confirmed by code, so master agents must be created manually before rename propagation applies.

integration_issues.flow: Master File rename -> Month MIS propagation
integration_issues.issue: Renaming customer 'Vishwa' to 'Vishwa Updated' saved successfully in Master File (no error) but the Apr-2026 MIS row still displayed 'Vishwa' (loan value has a trailing space). No user feedback that 0 loans were updated.

issues: Row 2 (Vishwa) shows bank 'TEST_Replace_Bank_1' - leftover QA data inside a real-looking loan record
master_banks contains leftover QA entries TEST_Detail_Bank, TEST_Replace_Bank_1, TEST_UI_Bank_1 from earlier iterations

action_items: Make rename propagation whitespace/case tolerant (regex ^\s*name\s*$ case-insensitive, with re.escape) across all 6 master PUT endpoints; also trim name fields when creating/importing loans and add a one-time migration to trim existing loan_applications name fields.
Return matched/modified loan counts from master PUT endpoints and surface it in the Master File toast.
Clean leftover QA data: master_banks TEST_Detail_Bank / TEST_Replace_Bank_1 / TEST_UI_Bank_1 and loan 1b7600b1-ef70-4aeb-a0cd-605c05da6e58 whose bank is TEST_Replace_Bank_1.
critical_code_review_comments: old_name interpolated directly into $regex in duplicate-name checks (master banks/companies/customers/executives/managers) without re.escape - names containing regex metacharacters can break the uniqueness check or match unintended docs.
Propagation is duplicated 6x with identical logic; extract a helper propagate_master_rename(collection, loan_field, old, new).

`result = await db....update_one(...)` assigned but unused in all 6 PUT endpoints (dead variable); 404 for unknown id is raised only after the duplicate-name check, so a duplicate name on a non-existent id returns 400 instead of 404.

success_rate.backend: 94% (15/16 pytest cases pass; 1 intentional bug-repro fails)
success_rate.frontend: 50% (clean-name rename propagates; whitespace-name rename does not)

seed_data_creation: Created and deleted one Apr-2026 loan plus TEST_* master entries (customers/executives/managers/banks/agents/companies) per run; all removed in fixtures. Renamed 'TestClient' and 'Vishwa' in UI and reverted both to originals.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_master_rename_propagation.py -v`. 15 cases must pass; test_rename_propagates_when_loan_value_has_whitespace is the bug-repro and should pass only after the trim/case-insensitive fix. Loan 1b7600b1-ef70-4aeb-a0cd-605c05da6e58 has customer_name 'Vishwa ' (trailing space) - use it to verify the fix from the UI (Master File -> edit Vishwa -> check Apr-2026 MIS). Month groups are collapsed by default; click [data-testid=month-header-Apr-2026].
rca_of_the_issue: All 6 master PUT endpoints propagate renames with db.loan_applications.update_many({field: old_name}, {'$set': {field: new_name}}). MongoDB equality is exact and case/whitespace sensitive. Preview loans imported from Excel retain untrimmed values ('Vishwa ') while master collections store trimmed names ('Vishwa'), so the filter matches 0 documents and the MIS row keeps the stale name while the master shows the new one.
